title: Countries

help.title: About Countries
help.overview: Countries are the root of the geography used by company, edifice, and other addresses. Each country requires a name, a two- or three-letter ISO code, and a phone calling prefix.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create or edit a country and keep its ISO code and calling prefix accurate.
Use the row menu to open States or Cities already scoped to that country.
Deleting a country is a soft delete and the record can be restored.

sections.title: How countries are used
items: Address forms select a country before any optional state and city context.
